methodology.UserFees: Swap and liquidity fees paid by traders. Excludes bribes, which are paid by third parties bidding for gauge votes, not by users.
methodology.Fees: Swap and liquidity fees charged by Curve pools, plus bribes paid to veCRV voters. Fee rates are set per pool - around 0.01%-0.04% on stable pools and up to a few percent on volatile pools.
methodology.Revenue: The share of pool fees kept by the protocol rather than paid to liquidity providers - usually half of the fee - plus bribes.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 10% of the protocol's share of pool fees, sent to the Curve DAO treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 90% of the protocol's share of pool fees, distributed to veCRV holders, plus all bribes.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The share of pool fees paid to liquidity providers - usually half of the fee.

Fees.CurveDEX Swap Fees: Swap and liquidity fees charged by Curve pools

Revenue.CurveDEX Admin Fees: Fees distributed to veCRV holders and protocol treasury

ProtocolRevenue.CurveDEX Admin Fees To Treasury: Fees allocated to the protocol treasury

HoldersRevenue.CurveDEX Fees To veCRV Holders: Fees distributed to veCRV governance token holders

methodology.UserFees: User pays 0.25% fees on each swap.
methodology.Fees: All fees comes from the user.
methodology.Revenue: All revenue generated comes from user fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 0.0575% is used to facilitate CAKE buyback and burn.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: User pays 0.25% fees on each swap

Revenue.Swap Fees To Holders: 0.0575% is used to facilitate CAKE buyback and burn.

HoldersRevenue.Buy Back And Burn CAKE: 0.0575% is used to facilitate CAKE buyback and burn.

methodology.UserFees: User pays fees on each swap.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees from paid by users.
methodology.Revenue: From 28 Dec 2025, a portion of fees a collected to buy back and burn UNI on Ethereum, From 8 Mar 2026, on Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, WC, Zora, XLayer, From 2 Jun 2026, on Polygon, BSC, Celo, From 27 Jul 2026, on Robinhood
methodology.HoldersRevenue: From 28 Dec 2025, a portion of fees a collected to buy back and burn UNI on Ethereum, From 8 Mar 2026, on Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, WC, Zora, XLayer, From 2 Jun 2026, on Polygon, BSC, Celo, From 27 Jul 2026, on Robinhood
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees distributed to LPs post protocol fee collection
methodology.Volume: Swap volume, excluding wash trading: pools whose daily trades come from too few distinct addresses to be organic, unless every pool token is a core asset or CoinGecko-listed.

methodology.Fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers + liquidation bonues earned by liquidators.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Total interests are distributed to suppliers/lenders + liquidation bonues to liquidators.

Fees.Borrow Interest: All interest paid by borrowers from all markets.
Fees.Liquidation Fees: All bonuses earned by liquidators from liquidations.

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest: All interests paid are distributedd to vaults suppliers, lenders.
SupplySideRevenue.Liquidation Fees: All bonuses earned by liquidators from liquidations.

methodology.HoldersRevenue: Holders do not earn any revenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity providers share from swap fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees to Liquidity Providers: Liquidity providers share from swap fees.

methodology.Fees: Ophis fees assessed on successfully settled Ophis-attributed fills, including the 1 bp base fee and capped price-improvement capture. Values come from Ophis' settlement-fill ledger, are bucketed by settlement date, and are valued in USD by the reporting indexer.
methodology.Revenue: Fees retained by Ophis. Ophis-operated chains retain the full fee; on CoW-hosted chains this is net of CoW Protocol's 25% partner-fee share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue retained by Ophis after CoW Protocol's hosted-chain share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: CoW Protocol's 25% share of Ophis fees on CoW-hosted chains; zero on Ophis-operated chains.

Fees.Ophis swap fees: Base and capped price-improvement fees assessed on successfully settled Ophis fills.

Revenue.Ophis protocol revenue: Fees retained by Ophis after any hosted-chain share.

ProtocolRevenue.Ophis protocol revenue: Fees retained by Ophis after any hosted-chain share.

SupplySideRevenue.CoW Protocol hosted-chain share: CoW Protocol's share on CoW-hosted chains.

methodology.UserFees: Traders pay the full swap fee on every trade.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders across GIGA DEX Classic (stable + volatile) and BrownFi oracle-based pools, per-pair fee rate read on-chain.
methodology.Revenue: Share of swap fees collected by the GIGA fee center for veGIGA stakers, read per pair on-chain (pair.protocolFee() on Classic, feeSplit on BrownFi): 100% on gauged pairs (pairs receiving GIGA emissions), 3% on non-gauged Classic pairs.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol treasury keeps no direct share of swap fees, it earns as a veGIGA staker.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Share of swap fees distributed to veGIGA stakers (all of the protocol's share).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Share of swap fees kept by liquidity providers: 0% on gauged pairs (LPs there earn GIGA emissions instead), 97% on non-gauged Classic pairs, the non-feeSplit part on BrownFi pairs.

UserFees.Trading fees: Full swap fee paid by traders on every trade.

Revenue.Protocol fees: Per-pool protocol share of swap fees, read on-chain, collected for veGIGA stakers.

HoldersRevenue.Tokenholder fees: Per-pool protocol share of swap fees distributed to veGIGA stakers.

SupplySideRevenue.LP fees: Swap fees kept by liquidity providers (total fees minus the veGIGA share).

methodology.UserFees: Traders pay the full swap fee on every trade.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on GIGA DEX CL pools, per the pool's fee tier.
methodology.Revenue: Share of swap fees collected by the GIGA fee center for veGIGA stakers, read per pool from slot0.feeProtocol: 100% on gauged pools (pools receiving GIGA emissions), 3% on non-gauged pools.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol treasury keeps no direct share of swap fees, it earns as a veGIGA staker.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Share of swap fees distributed to veGIGA stakers (all of the protocol's share).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Share of swap fees kept by liquidity providers: 0% on gauged pools (LPs there earn GIGA emissions instead), 97% on non-gauged pools.

UserFees.Trading fees: Full swap fee paid by traders on every trade.

Revenue.Protocol fees: Per-pool protocol share of swap fees, read on-chain, collected for veGIGA stakers.

HoldersRevenue.Tokenholder fees: Per-pool protocol share of swap fees distributed to veGIGA stakers.

SupplySideRevenue.LP fees: Swap fees kept by liquidity providers (total fees minus the veGIGA share).

methodology.Fees: Uniswap V3 swap fees generated by Goon-launched pools (pools with under $100 TVL are excluded as dust).
methodology.Revenue: The USD share of swap fees, minus whatever Uniswap's protocol fee switch (read live per pool via slot0().feeProtocol) diverts to Uniswap itself.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The token share of swap fees paid to the token creator, plus Uniswap's diverted cut of both swap fee legs (read live per pool via slot0().feeProtocol).

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Uniswap V3 swap fees generated by Goon-launched pools, split by which side of the swap was the input: USD-input fees (to protocol/Uniswap) and Token-input fees (to creator/Uniswap). Pools with under $100 TVL are excluded as dust.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees to Protocol: Swap fees charged when USD was the input token, minus Uniswap's live per-pool protocol fee cut, accrue to the protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Protocol: Swap fees charged when USD was the input token, minus Uniswap's live per-pool protocol fee cut, accrue to the protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Creators: Swap fees charged when the Token was the input token, minus Uniswap's live per-pool protocol fee cut, accrue to the token creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Uniswap: Uniswap's protocol fee switch cut of both swap fee legs, read live per pool via slot0().feeProtocol - no longer reaches Goon's protocol or the token creator.

methodology.Fees: Name registration and renewal fees for .robin names (annual rentals, plus temporary Dutch-auction premiums on recently expired names), paid in ETH or USDG or ROBIN.
methodology.Revenue: Same as fees: 100% of registration and renewal costs accrue to the protocol treasury (a 2-of-3 Safe). There are no third-party fee splits.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as revenue (100% of registration and renewal costs) — all fees accrue to the protocol treasury.

Fees.Name registration fees: Cost paid to register .robin names (base cost plus any temporary premium on recently expired names), in ETH or USDG or ROBIN.
Fees.Name renewal fees: Cost paid to renew .robin names, in ETH or USDG or ROBIN.

ProtocolRevenue.Name registration fees: Cost paid to register .robin names (base cost plus any temporary premium on recently expired names), in ETH or USDG or ROBIN.
ProtocolRevenue.Name renewal fees: Cost paid to renew .robin names, in ETH or USDG or ROBIN.

Revenue.Name registration fees: Cost paid to register .robin names (base cost plus any temporary premium on recently expired names), in ETH or USDG or ROBIN.
Revenue.Name renewal fees: Cost paid to renew .robin names, in ETH or USDG or ROBIN.

methodology.Fees: Transaction gas fees paid by users on Robinhood Chain (ETH), covering both L2 execution and the L1 data fee component.
methodology.Revenue: Transaction gas fees net of Ethereum L1 execution and blob costs and the 10% Arbitrum Expansion Program fee share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Ethereum L1 execution and blob costs paid for Robinhood Chain batch posting and rollup assertion transactions, plus the 10% Arbitrum Expansion Program share of net revenue paid to the Arbitrum DAO and developer fund.

Fees.Transaction Gas Fees: Robinhood Chain L2 transaction gas fees paid by users.

Revenue.Transaction Gas Fees: L2 transaction gas fees net of Ethereum L1 settlement costs and the Arbitrum Expansion Program fee share.

SupplySideRevenue.Ethereum L1 Execution Gas Costs: Ethereum execution gas paid by the Robinhood Chain batch poster and validators for L1 batch posting and rollup assertion transactions.
SupplySideRevenue.Ethereum L1 Blob Data Costs: Ethereum blob fees paid for Robinhood Chain blob-carrying batch posting transactions.
SupplySideRevenue.Arbitrum Expansion Program Fee Share: 10% of net revenue (fees minus L1 settlement costs) remitted under the Arbitrum Expansion Program: 8% to the Arbitrum DAO treasury and 2% to the developer fund.
